description: Check how an email will fare in dark mode. Pass `html`. Reports whether it declares color-scheme (meta and CSS), has a prefers-color-scheme: dark block, uses Outlook.com's [data-ogsc]/[data-ogsb] hooks, hard-codes white or near-white backgrounds, pairs colors that already have low contrast, uses mid-tone text colors that tend to fail after forced inversion, relies on background images, and has images likely to need a transparent or outlined version. Clients behave in three ways (leave as is, partly invert, fully invert); our notes describe them, and they drift. Email client support notes are from our own testing notes dated 2026-10 and may have drifted. Confirm in real clients (Litmus, Email on Acid, or seed accounts) before sending.
name: check_email_dark_mode
title: Email dark mode check
